tasks.title: Rewire the gemini agent definition to use the agy command (Antigravity CLI)
acceptance_criteria: harness/config.yaml defines the gemini agent with command 'agy' and args ['-p', '--sandbox'].
harness/config.yaml includes the new 'claude_fallback' agent definition with command 'agy' and args ['-m', 'claude-opus-4.6', '-p', '--dangerously-skip-permissions', '--sandbox'].
tasks.verification_command: python -c "import yaml; cfg = yaml.safe_load(open('harness/config.yaml')); assert cfg['agents']['gemini']['command'] == 'agy'; assert cfg['agents']['claude_fallback']['command'] == 'agy'"

spec.objective: Modify the default configuration to route Gemini requests through the Antigravity CLI and define the Claude fallback parameters.
functional_requirements: Change command of gemini to agy and set args to ['-p', '--sandbox'].
Add claude_fallback agent configuration pointing to agy command and selecting the claude-opus-4.6 model via the -m flag.
edge_cases: Ensure yaml syntax is fully valid.

tasks.title: Implement Claude Code rate limit fallback and write unit test suite
acceptance_criteria: harness/orchestrator.py run_both_agents detects when claude agent returns None, and falls back to running the 'claude_fallback' agent.
The fallback functions under both sequential (Antigravity Mode) and parallel thread-pool execution paths.
tests/unit/test_claude_fallback.py defines unit tests that mock the claude agent failing, and asserts that the orchestrator calls 'claude_fallback' as the replacement.

spec.objective: Add rate limit fallback orchestration logic to orchestrator.py and verify via a new unit test suite.
functional_requirements: Update run_both_agents to check if the result of the first agent (when it is 'claude') is None.
If the result is None, execute run_agent_phase with 'claude_fallback' and assign its result to the first agent's returned value.
Implement the fallback check for both sequential execution and parallel future-based execution.
Create tests/unit/test_claude_fallback.py containing test_claude_fallback_triggered and test_claude_fallback_not_triggered mock tests.
edge_cases: Ensure mock processes simulate timeout or failure returning None correctly.
Ensure that errors during the fallback do not crash the orchestrator, and return None cleanly.
